items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He used to try to play like Charlie Christian. He had all Charlie Christian’s records, so I used to listen to that.

ctx.x: Do you remember where any of these locations were?

Yes. One place they used to have them was the Ken Club – K-e-n. That was a cellar place – basement, I should say. George Wein and I met there together, because he was trying to play piano. We were about the same age. We used to hang out there. There was this guitarist by the name of Tom Brown. That’s who I used to work with a lot. He used to try to play like Charlie Christian.
